# cargo-rail

<!-- Generated by just docs; edit CLI help in src/, then regenerate. -->

[Command reference](README.md)

```text
Plan workspace work, check dependencies and visibility, and manage releases and compiler reuse.

Start here:
  cargo rail init             # Create repository policy
  cargo rail plan             # Decide required work
  cargo rail unify --check    # Check dependency changes

Docs: https://github.com/loadingalias/cargo-rail

Usage: cargo-rail [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  doctor       Inspect native compiler-cache capability
  cache        Install, inspect, or reclaim explicitly scoped compiler-cache state
  plan         Build an evidence-backed named-work plan
  surface      Analyze declaration reachability and repair visibility
  unify        Analyze and repair workspace dependency coherence
  init         Create sparse repository policy in rail.toml
  split        Split a crate to a standalone repository with Git history
  sync         Synchronize a monorepo with configured split repositories
  release      Plan and execute exact-SHA releases
  change       Manage pending release intent files
  clean        Clean generated artifacts owned by the current workspace
  config       Inspect effective repository policy
  completions  Generate shell completions
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

Global Options:
  -q, --quiet
          Suppress progress messages

  -v, --verbose
          Show additional operational detail

      --json
          Output as JSON where supported; rejected otherwise

      --config <PATH>
          Path to rail.toml config file (bypass search order)

      --workspace-root <PATH>
          Workspace root directory (default: current directory)
```
